title: Claude integrations: How to use Zapier with Claude (Sonnet 5, Opus 5, and more)
summary: Learn how to use Zapier to connect Claude to the rest of your apps and let automation carry out entire workflows for you.
body_markdown: You can also use the dedicated[Zapier Claude Anthropic integration](https://zapier.com/apps/anthropic-claude/integrations) to add a Claude step to your workflow (using your own Anthropic account). But we recommend using AI by Zapier instead: it offers more powerful features with prompt testing, knowledge sources, and agentic tool calling. Plus, it allows you to skip the token cost and offers more flexibility since you can easily switch to another AI model without rebuilding your workflow.
